column1: # Machine-local inputs for `figures/make.py data`. Copy to figures/inputs.local.tsv (git-ignored) and edit.
# key<TAB>value; ${key} expands an earlier key or an environment variable. Paths below are the thesis machine's.
# ---- human (A119b IsoSeq; CHM13 v2.0); development substrate
# (figures 1-3 are scored GENOME-WIDE on every contig each sample's annotation covers; the old keys human_regions and
# gorilla_sqanti_contigs are no longer read. The lab's stringtie/flair/isoseq GTFs above are ANNOTATION-FREE runs:
# StringTie -L without -G, FLAIR bam2bed + collapse without -f/--gtf (flair correct skipped), IsoSeq collapse.
# Annotation-guided StringTie/FLAIR GTFs go in samples.tsv columns stringtie_guided_gtf / flair_guided_gtf, as a path or
# a ${key} of this file; they feed only the separate guided path of figures 1-3.)
# ---- sample registry: figures/samples.tsv has one row per sample (6 samples, 4 species) whose cells name the keys of
# this file; `make.py samples --verify` prints it resolved. Genome-wide runs of every pipeline stage per sample:
# the reference individual's (KB3781) haplotype assemblies: the flag stage confirms reference-absent candidates on them
# no splice index exists for chimpanzee or orangutan: `make.py runs --stage index` builds these (~7 min / ~19 GB each)
# `make.py runs` per-call bounds (optional; defaults shown; none is part of a stage's key):
